say:2:1341122001:1.text: Callahan told us the acolytes at the Whiteridge Temple have to get up at four-thirty in the morning every day!
say:2:1341122001:1.source_cn: 听杨凯维奇修士说，白山修道院的修士和修女早晨四点半就要起床！

say:3:1341122002:1.text: They start the morning prayer at five, have breakfast at six, and attend various courses next. In the afternoon, they copy scriptures, study the Divine Light, and discuss the classics.
say:3:1341122002:1.source_cn: 五点开始晨祷，六点吃早饭，接着要去修习各项圣堂安排的课...

choice_prompt:4:1341122002.text: They start the morning prayer at five, have breakfast at six, and attend various courses next. In the afternoon, they copy scriptures, study the Divine Light, and discuss the classics.
choice_prompt:4:1341122002.source_cn: 五点开始晨祷，六点吃早饭，接着要去修习各项圣堂安排的课程。下午呢，则是抄写经文、研究圣光之力和讨论经典的时间。

say:6:1341122005:1.text: Chippy reveres Dura too, but waking up that early? Nothing can make Chippy skip the morning snuggle time!
say:6:1341122005:1.source_cn: 虽然满满也很崇敬艾雅女神，但四点半起床……不行不行，满...

say:7:1341122006:1.text: You lazybones! You promised to get up early every day to practice swordsmanship!
say:7:1341122006:1.source_cn: 懒满满，你明明说过要每天早起锻炼剑术的！

say:8:1341122007:1.text: I do practice every day, but not in the morning... Look at my sword! It's a bit worn out already!
say:8:1341122007:1.source_cn: 我有在锻炼的！虽然不一定是早晨……但我真的每天都有在练...

say:9:1341122008:1.text: Actually... Chippy really admires the acolytes for sacrificing so much for their beliefs.
say:9:1341122008:1.source_cn: 其实……满满是很佩服那些修士和修女啦，他们可以为了自己...

say:10:1341122009:1.text: Mind you, they only get two meals a day at the temple!
say:10:1341122009:1.source_cn: 毕竟修道院里一天只能吃两顿饭的！

choice_prompt:11:1341122009.text: Mind you, they only get two meals a day at the temple!
choice_prompt:11:1341122009.source_cn: 毕竟修道院里一天只能吃两顿饭的！

say:12:1341122010:1.source_cn: 啊，主人又在拐着弯说满满是吃货了！

say:13:1341122012:1.text: That's not the point Chippy is trying to make.
say:13:1341122012:1.source_cn: 其实……其实满满想说的重点也不是这个！

say:14:1341122013:1.text: I mean, if they can sacrifice so much for their beliefs, so can Chippy!
say:14:1341122013:1.source_cn: 满满是想说，他们可以为了信仰付出这么多，满满也可以！

say:15:1341122014:1.source_cn: 那满满的信仰是什么呢？

say:16:1341122015:1.text: Do you even have to ask, Hammie? It's Magister, of course!
say:16:1341122015:1.source_cn: 笨漫漫！当然——当然是主人了！
say:16:1341122015:1.male: Do you even have to ask, Hammie? It's Magister, of course!
say:16:1341122015:1.female: Do you even have to ask, Hammie? It's Magister, of course!

choice:11:0:1.text: I'm not surprised you know that...
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 果然是满满会关注的重点……
choice:11:0:1.male: I'm not surprised you know that...
choice:11:0:1.female: I'm not surprised you know that...

say:18:1341122011:1.text: Absolutely! Two meals just aren't enough!
say:18:1341122011:1.source_cn: 对啊，只吃两顿饭一定会饿的！

say:19:1341122003:1.text: Chippy seems quite interested! How about becoming an acolyte for a couple of days?
say:19:1341122003:1.source_cn: 满满似乎很有兴趣呢，要不要去当几天修士？

choice:4:1:2.text: That's how life is at a temple.
choice:4:1:2.male: That's how life is at a temple.
choice:4:1:2.female: That's how life is at a temple.
